title.zh: Anthropic发布Opus 4.8，强调更可靠的结果
title.en: Anthropic launches Opus 4.8, saying it's “more likely to flag uncertainties about its work and less likely to make unsupported claims”, at the same price as 4.7

summary.zh: Opus 4.8在价格与4.7相同的情况下，更倾向于标记不确定性并减少不支持的声明。

title.zh: Anthropic完成65亿美元H轮融资，估值达9650亿美元
title.en: Anthropic raised a $65B Series H at a $965B post-money valuation, overtaking OpenAI's $852B valuation, and says its revenue run rate crossed $47B this month

summary.zh: Anthropic超越OpenAI的8520亿美元估值，并宣布本月收入运行率突破470亿美元。

title.zh: YouTube推出AI驱动的高级播客功能
title.en: YouTube launches new Premium podcast features, including an AI-powered recommendation tool, an “Auto speed” setting, and a new on-the-go listening mode

summary.zh: 新功能包括AI推荐工具、“自动速度”设置和新的移动收听模式。

title.zh: Anthropic和OpenAI的编码代理找到市场契合点
title.en: Anthropic and OpenAI seem to have finally found product-market fit with coding agents, which are quickly becoming daily drivers for very well-paid professionals

summary.zh: 编码代理正迅速成为高薪专业人士的日常工具。

title.zh: Meta计划在大客户中嵌入工程师和产品经理
title.en: Memo: Meta plans to embed engineers and product managers inside large corporate customers as part of a new Enterprise Solutions unit to help deploy its AI tools

summary.zh: Meta将通过新成立的企业解决方案部门帮助客户部署AI工具。

title.zh: Mistral加速超级智能开发以确保欧洲技术独立
title.en: Mistral says it is accelerating superintelligence development to ensure Europe's independence from US tech giants, and signs deals to supply Airbus and BMW

summary.zh: Mistral与空客和宝马签署供应协议，推动欧洲技术自主。

title.zh: IBM与Red Hat投资50亿美元启动开源软件项目
title.en: IBM and Red Hat commit $5B to establish a new open-source software model, dubbed Project Lightwell, and will deploy 20,000 engineers globally, supported by AI

summary.zh: 新项目“Lightwell”将全球部署2万名工程师，并由AI支持。

title.zh: Kirkland & Ellis投入5亿美元开发自有AI平台
title.en: Kirkland & Ellis, the world's highest-grossing law firm, is setting aside $500M to build its own AI platform rather than rely on tools available to its rivals

summary.zh: 全球收入最高的律师事务所选择自建AI平台，而非依赖现有工具。

title.zh: Apollo和Blackstone筹集360亿美元购买Google TPU供Anthropic租赁
title.en: Sources: Apollo Global and Blackstone are working to bring additional investors into a ~$36B debt financing deal to purchase Google TPUs for Anthropic to lease

title.zh: 台湾科技公司完成创纪录的145亿美元债务交易
title.en: Taiwanese tech companies have completed a record $14.5B of debt deals so far in 2026, as they race to secure financing to meet soaring demand for AI capacity

summary.zh: 为满足AI容量激增的需求，台湾科技公司加速融资。

title.zh: 企业在印度的全球能力中心利用 AI 内部化创意工作
title.en: Companies are using AI at their global capability centers in India to bring more creative work in-house, cutting turnaround times and reliance on ad agencies

summary.zh: 通过使用 AI，企业减少了对广告代理的依赖，同时缩短了工作周期。

title.zh: 字节跳动开发自有 CPU 以支持 AI 基础设施需求
title.en: Sources: ByteDance is developing its own CPUs to support its growing AI infrastructure needs, as chip price hikes and supply shortages constrain expansion plans

summary.zh: 芯片价格上涨和供应短缺促使字节跳动开发自有 CPU，以满足其 AI 基础设施扩展需求。

title.zh: 欧盟准备紧急权力干预芯片供应链
title.en: Doc: the EU is preparing emergency powers to intervene in Europe's chip supply chains during shortages, including by forcing chipmakers to override contracts

summary.zh: 欧盟计划在芯片短缺期间干预供应链，包括强制芯片制造商优先履行特定合同。

title.zh: 谷歌计划在印度建造 150 亿美元 AI 数据中心引发水资源压力担忧
title.en: As Google plans to build a $15B AI data center hub in Visakhapatnam, India, locals and rights groups are raising concerns over “extremely high” water stress

summary.zh: 当地居民和权益团体对该项目可能导致的“极高”水资源压力表示担忧。

title.zh: IBM 计划五年内投资超 100 亿美元开发量子计算
title.en: IBM plans to invest more than $10B in quantum computing over five years as it aims to build the first large-scale, error-free quantum computer by 2029

summary.zh: 目标是在 2029 年前建成首台大规模、无错误的量子计算机。

title.zh: 英国研究人员使用谷歌 Willow 量子芯片解决超复杂问题
title.en: UK researchers gain access to Google's Willow quantum chip, which it says solves a problem in five minutes that would take supercomputers 10 septillion years

summary.zh: 谷歌称该芯片能在五分钟内解决需要超级计算机 10 万亿年才能完成的问题。

title.zh: Autodesk 以 36 亿美元全现金收购 MaintainX
title.en: Autodesk agrees to buy MaintainX, a company focused on maintenance tools, in an all-cash deal that values MaintainX at $3.6B

summary.zh: MaintainX 专注于维护工具，此次收购将增强 Autodesk 的产品组合。

title.zh: 欧盟全面审查京东 22 亿欧元收购德国 Ceconomy 的交易
title.en: The European Commission opens a full review of JD.com's €2.2B acquisition of Germany-based electronics retailer Ceconomy under its Foreign Subsidies Regulation

summary.zh: 根据《外国补贴条例》，欧盟对该交易展开全面审查。

title.zh: 消息称 Groq 正从现有投资者筹集至多 6.5 亿美元
title.en: Source: Groq is raising up to $650M from existing investors; the AI chipmaker earlier signed a $20B Nvidia licensing deal that saw much of its senior team leave

summary.zh: 此前，AI 芯片制造商 Groq 与 Nvidia 签署了 200 亿美元的许可协议，导致其高级团队大部分离职。

title.zh: Fonoa 完成 1.1 亿美元 C 轮融资并收购 PwC 的间接税平台
title.en: Fonoa, which helps enterprises manage indirect tax compliance, raised a $110M Series C led by Headline and acquired PwC's Indirect Tax Edge platform

summary.zh: 此次融资由 Headline 领投，收购将增强其间接税合规管理能力。

title.zh: Corgi完成1.06亿美元B1轮融资，估值达26亿美元
title.en: Corgi, which uses AI to provide insurance for startups, raised a $106M Series B1 at a $2.6B valuation, up from $1.3B on May 6, for a total funding of $378M

summary.zh: Corgi利用AI为初创公司提供保险服务，此次融资使其总融资额达到3.78亿美元。

title.zh: Triomics完成2200万美元B轮融资，专注于肿瘤学AI平台
title.en: Triomics, which is building an AI-powered platform to help oncologists automate data-heavy tasks, raised a $22M Series B, following a $15M Series A in 2024

summary.zh: Triomics此前在2024年完成了1500万美元的A轮融资。

title.zh: Reactor推出实时视频生成AI平台，完成5900万美元A轮融资
title.en: Reactor, which says its AI platform can generate video in real-time with near-zero latency, emerges from stealth with a $59M Series A led by Lightspeed

summary.zh: Reactor声称其平台可实现近乎零延迟的实时视频生成。

title.zh: Geordie AI完成3000万美元A轮融资，估值1.8亿美元
title.en: London-based Geordie AI, which builds a security and governance platform for AI agents, raised a $30M Series A led by Balderton at an estimated $180M valuation

summary.zh: 这家总部位于伦敦的公司专注于为AI代理构建安全和治理平台。

title.zh: Saris完成2880万美元A轮融资，专注银行后台自动化
title.en: Saris, which builds AI agents to automate back-office work for banks and credit unions, raised a $28.8M Series A led by 8VC

summary.zh: Saris开发AI代理以自动化银行和信用合作社的后台工作。

title.zh: Waymo推出与Zeekr合作设计的自动驾驶出租车Ojai
title.en: Waymo unveils Ojai, a vehicle designed in partnership with Zeekr for robotaxi use, initially for select riders in San Francisco, Los Angeles, and Phoenix

summary.zh: Ojai将首先在旧金山、洛杉矶和凤凰城为部分乘客提供服务。

title.zh: 消息称五角大楼计划与美国无人机公司合作以增加国内生产
title.en: Sources: the Pentagon is pursuing funding deals with US drone companies, potentially with equity stakes, to increase domestic production and lower weapon costs

summary.zh: 五角大楼可能通过股权投资等方式支持无人机公司，降低武器成本。

title.zh: 美国AI热潮吸走风险投资，非洲初创企业转向本地资金
title.en: As the US AI boom drains venture capital from Africa, startups on the continent are pivoting to domestic funding sources, like pension funds and local VC firms

summary.zh: 非洲初创企业开始依赖养老金和本地风投等国内资金来源。

title.zh: Cognition融资超10亿美元，扩展AI软件工程师Devin
title.en: More Devins in More Places (3 minute read)

summary.zh: Devin显著缩短了项目时间并提升了自动化，服务客户包括奔驰和Itaú。
summary.en: Cognition raised over $1B at a $26B valuation, with significant backing from major investors to expand Devin, an AI software engineer. Devin has significantly cut project times and improved automation for clients like Mercedes-Benz and Itaú. Cognition aims to further streamline software development by matching models to tasks while expanding its engineering capabilities.

title.zh: ElevenLabs发布Music v2音乐生成模型
title.en: ElevenLabs Music Generation Model (3 minute read)

summary.zh: 该模型可在单曲中切换音乐风格，同时保持人声和作曲的连贯性。
summary.en: ElevenLabs has released Music v2, a music-generation model capable of switching genres mid-track while maintaining vocal and compositional coherence.

title.zh: Biohub发布蛋白质生物学世界模型
title.en: Biohub releases a world model of protein biology (9 minute read)

summary.zh: Biohub推出了一个开放的蛋白质结构预测、设计和生物发现引擎，包括ESMC、ESMFold2和ESM Atlas，免费向全球科学界开放。
summary.en: Biohub has made its open discovery engine for protein structure prediction, design, and biological discovery available to researchers everywhere. The release includes ESMC, a state-of-the-art language model that has internalized the fundamental properties that govern protein biology; ESMFold2, a design engine designed to transform ESMC's sequence representations into atomically-resolved 3D structures of biomolecular complexes; and ESM Atlas, which makes ESMC's representations navigable across 6.8 billion protein sequences and 1.1 billion predicted structures. All three models are freely available to the global scientific community.

title.zh: 分析：Anthropic和OpenAI已找到产品市场契合点
title.en: I think Anthropic and OpenAI have found product-market fit (11 minute read)

summary.zh: 两家公司通过定价策略表明其编码和通用代理产品已找到市场契合点，企业用户支出显著增加。
summary.en: Both Anthropic and OpenAI have started aggressively pricing their APIs. This is likely because they have found product-market fit with coding/general-purpose agent products. Companies spending over $200 per month per user helps these businesses cover their costs much better than charging $10 to $20 per month per user. Coding agents amplify this spending significantly.

title.zh: 使用Codex构建自我改进的税务代理
title.en: Building self-improving tax agents with Codex (17 minute read)

summary.zh: OpenAI利用Codex在Thrive Holdings开发了一个能够自我改进的AI代理，用于处理复杂的税务申报。
summary.en: Real-world systems often behave differently in production than they do in the lab. Teams often discover these failures after launch, then spend weeks fixing them. That feedback loop is slow and manual. Today, it is possible to build agents that self-improve. This post looks at how OpenAI used Codex to build this type of agent at Thrive Holdings, resulting in an AI that can prepare increasingly complex tax returns.

title.zh: 通过Delta Weight Sync优化TRL中的权重同步
title.en: Shipping a Trillion Parameters With a Hub Bucket: Delta Weight Sync in TRL (4 minute read)

summary.zh: 介绍了一种通过传输变化的模型参数来减少异步强化学习中的权重同步负载的方法，显著节省带宽。
summary.en: The blog post introduces a method to reduce the weight synchronization payload in async RL using "Delta Weight Sync," which transmits only changed model parameters between RL steps, significantly reducing data transfer from gigabytes to megabytes. A Hugging Face Hub "bucket" manages high-frequency object storage, enabling separate locations for the trainer and inference engine without direct communication, leading to substantial bandwidth savings.

title.zh: NVIDIA推出LocateAnything以加速视觉语言定位
title.en: NVIDIA's LocateAnything for Faster Grounding (8 minute read)

summary.zh: LocateAnything是一种视觉语言定位框架，可并行解码边界框，提高处理速度。
summary.en: NVIDIA's LocateAnything is a vision-language grounding framework that decodes bounding boxes in parallel rather than token-by-token.

title.zh: 推出Apex：专为React Native优化的快速模型
title.en: Introducing Apex: A Fast, Specialized Model for React Native (6 minute read)

summary.zh: Apex是一款专注于React Native开发的编码模型，优化了性能与成本比，目前处于私测阶段。
summary.en: Apex is a React Native coding model trained to build apps by analyzing architecture decisions, fixing framework-specific issues, and reasoning about constraints. While it doesn't match frontier models on coding benchmarks, the optimized model significantly alters the performance-to-cost ratio within its specific domain. The model is still in development. It is now available in a private beta with selected teams.

title.zh: NVIDIA投资1500亿美元巩固台湾AI制造中心地位
title.en: Nvidia bets $150B on Taiwan as Trump's plan to make US an AI hub backfires (13 minute read)

summary.zh: NVIDIA计划每年投资1500亿美元，支持台湾成为AI革命的中心，并加强与TSMC及其他合作伙伴的关系。
summary.en: Nvidia will invest $150 billion a year to make sure that Taiwan remains at the epicenter of the AI revolution. The investment is aimed at cementing Taiwan as the world's tech manufacturing hub for a long time. Nvidia will create a new headquarters in Taiwan to expand its partnership with TSMC, benefit from close proximity to advanced packaging technology not yet available at TSMC's factories in the US, and boost its alliances with other nearby partners. Expanding the AI ecosystem helps Nvidia further its bottom line.

title.zh: 前Google和Apple研究人员创立Trajectory，提升AI反馈循环
title.en: Former Google and Apple researchers launch Trajectory to enhance AI feedback loops (3 minute read)

summary.zh: 这家位于帕洛阿尔托的新创公司致力于开发能够感知和解释物理世界的AI系统。
summary.en: The new Palo Alto-based startup aims to make AI systems that can actually see and interpret the physical world.

title.zh: DeepMind CEO预测AGI将在3到4年内实现
title.en: Google DeepMind's Hassabis: AGI is 3 to 4 years away (2 minute read)

summary.zh: Demis Hassabis预测AGI将在2029-2030年实现，比之前的估计提前。
summary.en: Google DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis now predicts AGI could be achieved by 2029-30, accelerating from his earlier estimate of 2030-2035.

title.zh: Google扩展Gemini for Business，推出可共享项目功能
title.en: Google expands Gemini for Business with shareable Projects (2 minute read)

summary.zh: Google为Gemini for Business新增可共享项目功能，支持团队在多平台工作空间中协作。
summary.en: Google enhances Gemini for Business with the introduction of shareable Projects, which allow team members to collaborate within dedicated multi-surface workspaces.

title.zh: Anthropic 将扩展 Claude 语音模式至更多语言
title.en: Anthropic to expand Claude Voice Mode to more languages (2 minute read)

summary.zh: Anthropic 计划将 Claude 的语音模式扩展到 18 种新语言。
summary.en: Anthropic plans to expand Claude's voice mode to 18 new languages.
